if(NEED_ROW_ONLY)
    # Minimal: row-reader only
    add_subdirectory(monitor)
    add_subdirectory(open_storage)
    add_subdirectory(py_interface_row_only)
else()
    # CPU_ONLY and Full GPU share the same subdirectory set;
    # differences are handled by #ifdef CPU_ONLY inside source files.
    add_subdirectory(dataset)
    add_subdirectory(framework)
    add_subdirectory(dataset_impl)
    add_subdirectory(py_interface)
    add_subdirectory(plugin)
    add_subdirectory(monitor)
    add_subdirectory(local_orc)
    add_subdirectory(arrow_reader)
    if (INTERNAL_VERSION)
        if (NOT _GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI EQUAL 1)
            add_subdirectory(odps)
        endif()
        add_subdirectory(open_storage)
        add_subdirectory(lake)
    endif(INTERNAL_VERSION)
    if(BUILD_TESTING)
        add_subdirectory(tests)
    endif()
endif()
